questions.explanation: Nagaram commonly referred to an organisation of merchants in a town or commercial settlement.

questions.topic: Medieval India: society and cultural connections
questions.question: Which kingdom was ruled by Queen Rudramadevi in the thirteenth century?
questions.explanation: Rudramadevi ruled the Kakatiya kingdom in the Deccan in the thirteenth century.

questions.topic: Medieval India: society and cultural connections
questions.question: Which region is associated with the sixteenth-century ruler Rani Durgavati?
questions.explanation: Rani Durgavati ruled in Gondwana and resisted Mughal expansion.

questions.topic: Medieval India: society and cultural connections
questions.question: Who commissioned the Vijay Stambha at Chittor?
questions.explanation: Rana Kumbha commissioned Chittor's Vijay Stambha to commemorate military success.
